current_answer: Choose by the job and the evidence path. Use OpenAI Product Design Ideate when Product Design is available in your Codex or ChatGPT Work environment and you need three image-based directions for a new or redesigned screen before any build starts. Give it a minimum brief and the project references it needs, then choose one direction. It is a mutable-source plugin skill, not a source-pinned file, and the pool did not run it. Use Frontend App Builder when you need its Build Web Apps concept-to-browser workflow instead. The other lanes remain separate: Anthropic Frontend Design for text-led visual direction; PracticalSwan Frontend Design 2.0 for substantial work with an explicit state model; Wenkang Frontend Design for human visual decisions on a real route; Vercel skills for React composition, transitions, UI review, and performance; Agent Browser and Dogfood for capture and exploratory QA; Frontend Testing & Debugging for a named rendered change; and Product Design Audit for a captured flow. Eleven of thirteen listings are source-pinned. Frontend Testing & Debugging and Product Design Ideate are current mutable sources. None has been independently installed, executed, or compared on a shared frontend task by this pool.
